message.content:
Sure! To help you track your complaint’s progress, here are some common ways you can check its status:

| Where You Filed It | How to Check Status |
|--------------------|---------------------|
| **Online portal / website** | Log in to your account → “My Complaints” or “Support Tickets.” Your ticket number will show current status (“Open,” “In Review,” “Resolved”). |
| **Email submission** | Search your inbox for an auto‑reply from our team – it usually contains a reference ID. Reply to that thread or use the link in the reply to view updates. |
| **Phone call** | Call our dedicated complaints line at [Insert Phone Number]. Have your reference number handy. |
| **Live chat / chatbot** | Start a new conversation on our site/app → select “Complaints” or “Customer Support.” Provide your reference ID to pull up details. |

If none of those options apply—perhaps you used a third‑party form or mailed us—the quickest route is to reach out directly through one of the above methods. If you’re unsure where you lodged the complaint, let me know the approximate time/date or the method you think you used, and I’ll try to point you toward the right place.
